# The Drowned Arsenal of Ovdal Tungr (526). Generated by "Claude files/tools/ovdal_tungr_2026-11-12/gen.py".
# Country scope unless said.

DA_OT_remove_slips = {
	remove_country_modifier = DA_OT_slips_1
	remove_country_modifier = DA_OT_slips_2
	remove_country_modifier = DA_OT_slips_3
	remove_country_modifier = DA_OT_ironclad_yards_1
	remove_country_modifier = DA_OT_ironclad_yards_2
	remove_country_modifier = DA_OT_ironclad_yards_3
}

# the Slips: the two country modifiers of the tier the arsenal stands at; none without the hold
DA_OT_sync = {
	DA_OT_remove_slips = yes
	if = {
		limit = { DA_OT_arsenal_at_tier_3 = yes }
		add_country_modifier = { name = DA_OT_slips_3 duration = -1 }
		add_country_modifier = { name = DA_OT_ironclad_yards_3 duration = -1 hidden = yes }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { DA_OT_arsenal_at_tier_2 = yes }
		add_country_modifier = { name = DA_OT_slips_2 duration = -1 }
		add_country_modifier = { name = DA_OT_ironclad_yards_2 duration = -1 hidden = yes }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { DA_OT_arsenal_at_tier_1 = yes }
		add_country_modifier = { name = DA_OT_slips_1 duration = -1 }
		add_country_modifier = { name = DA_OT_ironclad_yards_1 duration = -1 hidden = yes }
	}
}

# one captain. The names are saved by the caller (the way DA_Leader_Admiral_creation_effects.txt does it).
DA_OT_define_admiral = {
	random_list = {
		50 = { define_admiral = { fire = $fire$ shock = $shock$ manuever = $manuever$ siege = 0 trait = $trait$ name = root_name_male } }
		50 = { define_admiral = { fire = $fire$ shock = $shock$ manuever = $manuever$ siege = 0 trait = $trait$ female = yes name = root_name_female } }
	}
}

DA_OT_recruit_pilot = {
	hidden_effect = {
		set_saved_name = { key = root_name_male type = advisor scope = ROOT }
		set_saved_name = { key = root_name_female type = advisor female = yes scope = ROOT }
		if = {
			limit = { DA_OT_arsenal_at_tier_3 = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { navy_tradition = 50 }
				DA_OT_define_admiral = { fire = 3 shock = 2 manuever = 5 trait = DA_OT_pilot_personality }
			}
			else = {
				DA_OT_define_admiral = { fire = 2 shock = 2 manuever = 5 trait = DA_OT_pilot_personality }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { DA_OT_arsenal_at_tier_2 = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { navy_tradition = 50 }
				DA_OT_define_admiral = { fire = 3 shock = 1 manuever = 4 trait = DA_OT_pilot_personality }
			}
			else = {
				DA_OT_define_admiral = { fire = 2 shock = 1 manuever = 4 trait = DA_OT_pilot_personality }
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { navy_tradition = 50 }
				DA_OT_define_admiral = { fire = 2 shock = 1 manuever = 3 trait = DA_OT_pilot_personality }
			}
			else = {
				DA_OT_define_admiral = { fire = 1 shock = 1 manuever = 3 trait = DA_OT_pilot_personality }
			}
		}
		clear_saved_name = root_name_male
		clear_saved_name = root_name_female
	}
}

DA_OT_recruit_gunner = {
	hidden_effect = {
		set_saved_name = { key = root_name_male type = advisor scope = ROOT }
		set_saved_name = { key = root_name_female type = advisor female = yes scope = ROOT }
		if = {
			limit = { DA_OT_arsenal_at_tier_3 = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { navy_tradition = 50 }
				DA_OT_define_admiral = { fire = 5 shock = 2 manuever = 3 trait = DA_OT_gunner_personality }
			}
			else = {
				DA_OT_define_admiral = { fire = 5 shock = 2 manuever = 2 trait = DA_OT_gunner_personality }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { DA_OT_arsenal_at_tier_2 = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { navy_tradition = 50 }
				DA_OT_define_admiral = { fire = 4 shock = 1 manuever = 3 trait = DA_OT_gunner_personality }
			}
			else = {
				DA_OT_define_admiral = { fire = 4 shock = 1 manuever = 2 trait = DA_OT_gunner_personality }
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { navy_tradition = 50 }
				DA_OT_define_admiral = { fire = 3 shock = 1 manuever = 2 trait = DA_OT_gunner_personality }
			}
			else = {
				DA_OT_define_admiral = { fire = 3 shock = 1 manuever = 1 trait = DA_OT_gunner_personality }
			}
		}
		clear_saved_name = root_name_male
		clear_saved_name = root_name_female
	}
}

			limit = { DA_OT_arsenal_at_tier_3 = yes }

			}

		clear_saved_name = root_name_female
	}
}

DA_OT_begin_study_copper = {
	set_country_flag = DA_OT_study_copper
	set_variable = { which = DA_OT_study_months value = 12 }
}

DA_OT_begin_study_casemate = {
	set_country_flag = DA_OT_study_casemate
	set_variable = { which = DA_OT_study_months value = 18 }
}

DA_OT_begin_study_ram = {
	set_country_flag = DA_OT_study_ram
	set_variable = { which = DA_OT_study_months value = 18 }
}

DA_OT_begin_study_engines = {
	set_country_flag = DA_OT_study_engines
	set_variable = { which = DA_OT_study_months value = 24 }
}

DA_OT_begin_study_dreadnought = {
	set_country_flag = DA_OT_study_dreadnought
	set_variable = { which = DA_OT_study_months value = 36 }
}

# the drawing under the scribes is finished: its blueprint can be chosen in the Ironclad designer
DA_OT_finish_study = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_OT_study_copper }
		clr_country_flag = DA_OT_study_copper
		set_country_flag = DA_Unlocked.Ironclad_Copper_Sheathed_Hull
		set_country_flag = DA_OT_copied_copper
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_OT_study_casemate }
		clr_country_flag = DA_OT_study_casemate
		set_country_flag = DA_Unlocked.Ironclad_Casemate_Battery
		set_country_flag = DA_OT_copied_casemate
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_OT_study_ram }
		clr_country_flag = DA_OT_study_ram
		set_country_flag = DA_Unlocked.Ironclad_Ram_of_Aul_Dwarov
		set_country_flag = DA_OT_copied_ram
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_OT_study_engines }
		clr_country_flag = DA_OT_study_engines
		set_country_flag = DA_Unlocked.Ironclad_Strongbellow_Engines
		set_country_flag = DA_OT_copied_engines
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_OT_study_dreadnought }
		clr_country_flag = DA_OT_study_dreadnought
		set_country_flag = DA_Unlocked.Ironclad_Dreadnought
		set_country_flag = DA_OT_copied_dreadnought
	}
	set_variable = { which = DA_OT_study_months value = 0 }
	country_event = { id = DA_Ovdal_Tungr_event.40 }
}

# every month, for the owner of Ovdal Tungr and for a country that still carries the Slips modifiers
DA_OT_monthly = {
	if = {
		limit = { DA_OT_old_save_leftovers = yes }
		DA_OT_convert_old_save = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { DA_OT_arsenal_found = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { DA_OT_slips_in_step = yes } }
			DA_OT_sync = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { DA_OT_arsenal_at_tier_1 = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_enable_metallurgy_System_ship } }    # a new owner of a restored arsenal
			DA_enable_Metal_Ship = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { DA_OT_any_study = yes }
			subtract_variable = { which = DA_OT_study_months value = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_OT_study_months value = 1 } } }
				DA_OT_finish_study = yes
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				DA_OT_arsenal_at_tier_3 = yes
				NOT = { DA_OT_hull_ruled = yes }
				OR = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_OT_ruling_asked } had_country_flag = { flag = DA_OT_ruling_asked days = 60 } }    # asked once; again if the event could not fire
			}
			set_country_flag = DA_OT_ruling_asked
			country_event = { id = DA_Ovdal_Tungr_event.4 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_OT_fmod_keel }
				526 = { has_province_flag = DA_OT_hull_launched has_province_flag = DA_Ovdal_Tungr_exp3 }
			}
			set_country_flag = DA_OT_fmod_keel
			country_event = { id = DA_Ovdal_Tungr_event.41 }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { DA_OT_any_slips = yes }    # the hold is lost: the Slips lapse; a drawing under the scribes waits
		DA_OT_remove_slips = yes
	}
}

# a save from before the Drowned Arsenal: the shipyard found becomes the wonder at tier 0, which carries the old modifier's numbers.
# A Gargantuan Flagship already bought (country flag DA_Flagship_mod1) stays as it is.
DA_OT_convert_old_save = {
	526 = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_province_flag = DA_dwarven_shipyard_found NOT = { has_great_project = { type = DA_Drowned_Arsenal } } }
			add_great_project = { type = DA_Drowned_Arsenal instant = yes }
		}
		remove_province_modifier = DA_Aul_dwarov_shipyard
	}
}
